title: Kefalopoda Inequalities and Definite Causal Order for Multi-Party Binary Experiments
banked_reason: D0.5.G tier=incremental < floor=field and NOT salvageable in scope; math review passed, while the bounded boundary-scope repair cannot lift the 6.3 ceiling to 7.4.
gap_reasons: The restricted experiment and lack of an application demonstrating econometric use limit the projected score at a leading econometrics journal.
The published journal text remains inaccessible for verification of the load-bearing novelty comparison.

The core proves equality when either alphabet has size at most two and gives only a 3-by-3 counterexample, so its tldr/project claims of a sharp alphabet-size boundary need either an all-|X|,|A|>=3 strictness statement (with the zero/duplicate-row embedding) or narrowing to the displayed 3-by-3 obstruction.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived an all-party source-digraph hull theorem, an exact normalized source-first operational characterization, rational separation certificates, and a finite-alphabet overlap theorem; the math referee reported PASS with no findings. The package was downgraded because the general referee assessed only incremental novelty at a 6.3 ceiling versus the 7.4 field floor. A routine embedding or narrower prose would repair the remaining alphabet-boundary scope overclaim, but would not raise the contribution to the required field tier.
tldr: For binary-input, binary-output public-pair experiments, ask whether the probability box and signed kefalopoda inequalities suffice for normalized definite causal order for every party count. The proposed all-party source-digraph hull and corrected-facet equivalence yield direct source-first protocols and polynomial-size exact rational witnesses. The source’s literal all-facet class collapses to input-independent tables. A finite-alphabet overlap criterion and a known three-law coupling example, embedded in the two-party experiment, mark the sharp boundary of pairwise-TV sufficiency.
gap: BTW2025 arXiv v1 and the indexed BTW2026 journal version give selector facets and the membership scan but leave all-party hull and operational sufficiency open. Literal Definition 14 also signs lower facets, yielding a smaller class than its prose suggests.
